note: Starter heroes are available from the start. Advanced heroes unlock after the listed level, just before the theme they suit best. Upgrades unlock by levels cleared with that hero, which rewards trying different heroes.

defaultBehavior.text: Move forward 1. If blocked, rotate clockwise to the nearest open tile and move; otherwise wait.

upgrades.name: Cleave
upgrades.effect: Slash also hits the tile behind the target.

upgrades.name: Parry
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, reduce one hit by 1.

upgrades.name: Heavy Boots
upgrades.effect: Ignore the first push per turn.

defaultBehavior.text: Scan the 180° forward arc, then move 1 toward the safest open tile (away from adjacent enemies).

upgrades.name: Quickdraw
upgrades.effect: Arrow range +1 (max 4).

upgrades.name: Pinning Shot
upgrades.effect: Arrow applies snare_root for 1 loop.

upgrades.name: Evasion
upgrades.effect: First melee hit per turn deals 1 less.

defaultBehavior.text: Hold if an enemy is visible; otherwise move forward 1 (rotate clockwise if blocked).

upgrades.name: Fortify
upgrades.effect: Wait/Hold grants ranged_resist 1 until your next action.

upgrades.name: Bulwark
upgrades.effect: Ignore the first trap damage per turn (statuses still apply).

upgrades.name: Bash Mastery
upgrades.effect: Shield Bash pushes even into a tile with a trap.

defaultBehavior.text: If a hazard is ahead, sidestep to the first safe open tile (clockwise); else move forward.

upgrades.name: Smoke Step
upgrades.effect: Ignore the smoke visibility penalty.

upgrades.name: Trap Sense
upgrades.effect: Hazard and trap sensors see 1 tile further.

upgrades.name: Backstab
upgrades.effect: Stab bonus becomes +3.

defaultBehavior.text: Wait when safe; step aside when threatened; otherwise advance.

upgrades.name: Antitoxin
upgrades.effect: Poison never stacks above 1 on you.

upgrades.name: Neutralizer
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, a vial that lands on fog or smoke clears it for 2 loops.

upgrades.name: Volatile Mix
upgrades.effect: Vial also hits the 4 tiles around the target.

defaultBehavior.text: Move forward; if blocked, turn toward the first open direction clockwise and move in the same loop.

upgrades.name: Vent Mastery
upgrades.effect: The first vent damage each turn is 0.

upgrades.name: Push Plate Resist
upgrades.effect: Immune to push plates.

upgrades.name: Discipline
upgrades.effect: Stun chance 40%.

defaultBehavior.text: Move forward, but treat visible curse sigils as walls.

upgrades.name: Cleanse
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, after acting, remove one negative status.

upgrades.name: Ward
upgrades.effect: Immune to fear and cursed during the first 2 loops of each turn.

upgrades.name: Blessed Strike
upgrades.effect: Smite reach 2; undead bonus +3.

defaultBehavior.text: If an enemy is adjacent, step aside; else move forward.

upgrades.name: Illumination
upgrades.effect: Illuminate radius +1; the first illusion-wall impact each turn deals 0.

upgrades.name: Wardbreaker
upgrades.effect: Arc Bolt ignores 1 armor.

upgrades.name: Curse Mitigation
upgrades.effect: cursed and fear last 1 loop on you.

defaultBehavior.text: Hold if an enemy is visible; otherwise advance.

upgrades.name: Pierce
upgrades.effect: Spear Thrust ignores 1 armor.

upgrades.name: Brace
upgrades.effect: Immune to pushback while holding.

upgrades.name: Crowd Control
upgrades.effect: Spear Thrust applies slowed for 1 loop.

defaultBehavior.text: Move toward the nearest visible enemy; if none, move forward.

upgrades.name: Rage Meter
upgrades.effect: After taking damage, the next Heavy Strike deals +1.

upgrades.name: Blood Resistance
upgrades.effect: Bleed never stacks above 1 on you.

upgrades.name: Unstoppable
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, ignore snare_root on a move.

defaultBehavior.text: If an enemy is within 2 tiles, move away; else move forward.

upgrades.name: Snare Control
upgrades.effect: snare_root you apply lasts 1 extra loop.

upgrades.name: Trap Interaction
upgrades.effect: Once per turn, ignore snare roots and bleed vines when moving.

upgrades.name: Tracking
upgrades.effect: Enemies standing on blood tiles count as marked for Volley.

defaultBehavior.text: Move toward the nearest visible enemy, preferring tiles next to blood tiles; if none, move forward.

upgrades.name: Blood Sense
upgrades.effect: Blood Trail Nearby sees 1 tile further; wounded enemies are visible through smoke.

upgrades.name: Finisher
upgrades.effect: Execute bonus applies at or below two-thirds HP.

upgrades.name: Trophy Hunter
upgrades.effect: Double drop chance from enemies with 3+ skulls.
